name: mock-sessions
description: WireMock stand-in for an A2A 1.0 agent that runs a helper as a session (child-sessions/v1, ADR 0072; local development only). Its parent task opens one session and ends while the helper works; the round is served by task to a client that activates the extension, and refused (InvalidParams) to one that does not.

extensions.description: Runs its helpers as sessions a client can open, talk to and close.
Reports the steps of its work.
Reports the tokens of each model call and the task's totals.
Takes a message into a working task.

skills.name: Delegate
skills.description: Hands a request to a planner helper, as a session, and reports what it found.
